remarks: Welcome to 18 Tod Rd, a completely renovated gem in Norwalk, CT! This stunning home has been fully gutted and thoughtfully redesigned to offer modern comfort and style. Featuring 3 spacious bedrooms and 2 beautifully updated bathrooms, this 1,444-square-foot residence is move-in ready and offers a fresh, contemporary feel throughout. The brand-new kitchen is a chef's dream, equipped with sleek countertops, high-end appliances, and ample storage. The open-concept living space, highlighted by a cozy fireplace, is perfect for entertaining or relaxing . Every detail in this home has been carefully considered, from the flooring to the lighting, ensuring a stylish yet functional environment. Outside, you'll enjoy a well-maintained yard on a 0.29-acre lot, perfect for outdoor gatherings or peaceful moments in nature. The home also features brand-new central air, oil tank, a new roof, and new driveway . Located in a prime Norwalk neighborhood with easy access to shopping, dining, transportation, and major highways, 18 Tod Rd offers the perfect blend of luxury, convenience, and location. Don't miss your chance to own this turnkey property.
